Conclusion: 像素、图块和网格无需成为感知架构的接口，原子化接口可泛化到规则栅格之外，为更灵活的感知架构设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.

</details>


### [183] [I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40333)
*Ivan Martinović,Lukas Knobel,Yuki M. Asano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究从连续视频流中自监督学习（不打乱、不重复），构建WT++数据集，发现批内高相似性是主挑战，提出StreamMAE显著改善流式预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自监督预训练对图像独立采样并全局打乱、多轮重放，与婴儿连续视觉发展不符。作者希望研究在连续视频流、按时间顺序、严格滑窗批次下（无打乱、无重放）的自监督学习。

Method: 构建95小时城市步行游览视频流数据集WT++用于流式预训练，并设计评测套件。分析发现对比学习和蒸馏方法表现差，MAE较稳健但仍不及i.i.d.预训练。实验表明批次间相似性不是主因，批内近重复帧（高批内相似性）才是关键。提出StreamMAE，保留MAE重建目标，加入流感知正则与运动偏置裁剪选择。

Result: StreamMAE优于流式基线，匹配在相同视频数据上i.i.d.训练的MAE，与ImageNet预训练MAE相当，并随预训练流从12小时增至95小时呈现正向扩展。

Conclusion: 连续视频流预训练的主要挑战是批内高相似性而非批间相似性；StreamMAE通过流感知正则与运动偏置裁剪有效缓解，实现可扩展的流式自监督预训练。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

</details>


### [184] [Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40347)
*Owais Iqbal,Sudipta Sarkar,Shyam Marjit,Omprakash Chakraborty,Anirban Chakraborty,Abir Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoMSN，一个基于掩码孪生网络的帧无重建视频自监督时空表征学习框架，用标准图像ViT处理"超级图像"，高效达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频自监督学习依赖沉重的3D架构或基于重建的自编码器，计算成本高、预训练轮次多。作者希望利用图像基础模型实现高效视频表征学习。

Method: 将视频表示为帧采样组成的网格"超级图像"，用标准图像ViT处理。构造两个视图（空间patch掩码与时间帧掩码，避免跨帧信息泄漏），共享ViT编码器通过掩码孪生损失对齐嵌入，无需解码器与重建。

Result: 在DINO-v3和DeiT-v3图像编码器预训练基础上，于Kinetics-400、UCF101、HMDB51上达到SOTA，视频预训练轮次分别减少最高32倍和160倍，并在低样本分类中表现强劲。

Conclusion: 该方法证明图像基础模型可用于高效视频自监督学习，表征迁移性强，适用于标签稀缺场景。

Abstract: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

</details>


### [185] [AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40353)
*Jiahao Zhang,Yeying Fan,Moitreya Chatterjee,Suhas Lohit,Bernhard Egger,Tim K. Marks,Anoop Cherian,Stephen Gould*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AssemblyWorld交互式3D环境与AssemblyWorldBench基准，考察通用预训练智能体无需装配微调能否通过视觉交互完成3D装配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究通用预训练智能体能否仅凭视觉交互完成精确3D装配，无需额外装配专用微调，并衡量近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距。

Method: 构建交互式3D环境AssemblyWorld：智能体通过2D渲染视图感知零件几何、操作刚体零件，可参考图像或装配手册，装配结果按几何方式评估而非直接访问mesh顶点。基于此构建AssemblyWorldBench，含80个物体、100个装配任务，覆盖家具、工业装配与断裂重组。

Result: 评估8个智能体系统差异显著：最强系统零件准确率80.9%，完整装配成功率59.4%；开源系统在执行可靠性和装配精度上均明显落后于较强闭源系统。

Conclusion: AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配智能体能力、刻画近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距提供了统一平台。

Abstract: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

</details>


### [186] [ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40356)
*Xinghao Chen,Xiangbo Gao,Jiongze Yu,Yuheng Wu,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ViTeX-Bench，一个视频场景文本编辑的基准套件，包含387个真实720p视频数据集与三轴评估协议，并发布开源参考编辑器ViTeX-Edit-14B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成日益成熟，但视频编辑尤其是需保留原始场景动态的精确局部编辑仍不足。视频场景文本编辑（如店面招牌、白板）需要兼顾视觉质量、时序一致性与编辑局部性，然而现有配对真实视频数据有限，通用视频编辑指标也无法直接衡量文本随时间的正确性。

Method: 构建ViTeX-Bench，含ViTeX-Dataset和三轴评估协议。数据集包括387个真实720p视频，带文本区域掩码和编辑指令：230个经审核的管线生成配对编辑用于训练，157个作为冻结评测集。协议通过13项指标评估文本正确性、视觉与时序质量、编辑局部性，每轴一个主指标并做Pareto权衡比较，辅以OCR校准、人工评估和标注敏感性分析。同时发布在配对训练集上微调的ViTeX-Edit-14B，采用运动对齐的字形-视频条件。

Result: 在来自四个编辑家族的八个基线上，准确的文本、时序稳定性和场景保留难以同时达成。ViTeX-Edit-14B取得CharAcc 0.688，为所评测视频原生编辑器中最高均值，并在原始编辑器输出中拥有最低的可比文本裁剪Warp。

Conclusion: ViTeX-Bench为研究视频场景文本编辑中的这些权衡提供了可复现的基础。

Abstract: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

</details>


### [187] [Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40358)
*Liming Lu,Xianzheng Ma,Wenkun He,Guanqi Zhan,Yilin Zhao,Junyu Chen,Mengyao Xu,Jiaojiao Fan,Wenhang Ge,Yuchao Gu,Yunze Liu,Boyi Li,Zhen Dong,Victor Prisacariu,Ming-Yu Liu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Physis-Lang 提出以"物理语言"作为共享可优化表示，统一数据筛选、模型训练与视频生成，使物理世界模型生成更符合物理规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型常生成视觉上逼真但违背物理规律的视频。已有方法多认为自然语言不足以表达可靠生成所需的物理知识，因而引入视觉、隐变量、数值或规划等额外信号。本文重新审视该假设。

Method: 提出 Physis-Lang 自演化框架，用语言描述物理过程的实体、成因、交互、规律、时序演化与效果；构建 PhysCapBench 将物理过程拆解为原子断言，用召回率和精确率评估字幕；通过智能体循环分析断言级错误并优化生成物理字幕的指令；并将模型缺陷转为文本描述，用语言引导检索找到覆盖缺失物理过程的多样视频。

Result: 在四个常用物理视频基准上，基于 Wan 和 Cosmos 主干均获得一致的物理合理性提升；尤其在开源 Cosmos3-Nano 主干上，Physis-Lang 增强模型超越了领先的专有模型 Veo 3.1。

Conclusion: 自然语言足以作为物理知识的共享可优化表示，无需额外模态信号；Physis-Lang 通过语言闭环显著提升视频世界模型的物理一致性。

Abstract: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

</details>


### [188] [Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40362)
*Hongyuan Tao,Xinggang Wang,Lianghui Zhu,Yongkang Li,Yunchao Wei,Bin Feng,Shaoyu Chen,Qian Zhang,Chang Huang,Kai Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Multimodal Flow (MF-1) 提出一种全连续的多模态生成模型，通过共享的 chunk-causal flow backbone 统一建模语言与视觉，避免离散化瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型要么将图像量化离散化带来视觉瓶颈，要么混合离散语言与连续图像需要模态相关目标与采样流程；全连续建模可避免这些权衡但尚未充分探索。

Method: 采用统一连续架构，将文本块与图像组织为有序连续 hyperchunks，经 Flow Matching 学习单一向量场，结合联合注意力实现跨模态交互，模态专用 FFN 处理各模态，训练并行预测多个目标 chunk，推理顺序生成。

Result: 在 0.6B/1.2B/1.6B 规模上持续预训练均有提升；仅用 150B token，GenEval 与 DPG-Bench 平均 82.8，VQAv2/MMBench/POPE 平均 75.3，与更多数据训练的模型竞争力强；同等预算下优于代表性混合与离散模型。

Conclusion: 确立连续 chunk 嵌入流建模为统一多模态建模的全连续新范式，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [189] [Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38181)
*Juan M Zambrano Chaves,Peniel Argaw,Risa Ueno,Carlo Bifulco,Kristina Young,Rom Leidner,Tristan Naumann,Hoifung Poon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Survprompt 框架，将结构化患者协变量转为自由文本临床小故事，用预训练 LLM 零样本预测生存时间，并在两个多机构泛癌队列上与随机生存森林（RSF）等传统模型对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者确诊后可能直接向消费级 LLM 询问预后，但 LLM 能否给出准确生存预测尚未被严格评估。

Method: 构建 Survprompt：把结构化协变量转为文本 vignette，零样本提示 LLM 预测生存；在 MSK-CHORD 和新构建的 Providence St. Joseph Health Network 两个泛癌队列上，与 RSF 等传统生存模型进行基准比较；采用 cMAE 与 c-index 评估，并做特征消融分析。

Result: 前沿 LLM 的个体生存时间 cMAE 出人意料地有竞争力：如 GPT-5.6-Sol 在若干癌种上 cMAE 与专门训练的 SOTA RSF 相差 10% 以内，前列腺癌上甚至低于 RSF；特征消融显示 LLM 关注的临床变量与专用模型类似。但 LLM 在不同癌种和机构间准确性不一致，且对高低风险患者区分能力差（c-index 较低）。

Conclusion: 零样本 LLM 无需专门训练即可产生相当准确的预后估计，但跨癌种、跨机构的性能不稳定是临床应用中不可忽视的局限。

Abstract: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.

</details>


### [190] [Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39072)
*Yutong Hu,Jinho Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于LLM的多模态对话情感评估框架，在IEMOCAP上同时做离散情感识别与VAD维度评估，将声学线索转为自然语言描述。LoRA微调的LLaMA显著优于提示工程的大规模GPT，Valence CCC达0.7822，刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在对话情感识别中已被广泛研究，但在多模态对话的连续维度情感（VAD）评估上仍鲜有探索。

Method: 沿用SpeechCueLLM思路，将声学线索转为自然语言描述；在IEMOCAP上评估LLaMA、GPT、Qwen共6个模型，采用零样本、少样本提示与LoRA微调三种方式。

Result: LoRA微调的LLaMA在两个任务上大幅超越提示工程的GPT（归因于领域适应而非模型容量）；最佳Valence CCC=0.7822，创IEMOCAP新SOTA；消融显示文本化音频描述对小模型提升显著（+3.5~3.6 weighted F1），对最大模型作用微弱。

Conclusion: 音频线索在语言能力受限时价值最大；VAD各维度性能差异与IEMOCAP标注者一致性层级高度吻合。

Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

</details>


### [191] [TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38201)
*Jiangnan Yu,Ceyu Xu,Mengming Li,Shiyu Huang,Yiran Xia,Jian Weng,Hui Xue,Haohui Mai,Yuan Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 TomasuLLM 运行时，将 coding agent 的工具调用乱序执行并在验证后按轨迹顺序提交，用推测执行隐藏长耗时工具延迟，零误接受。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: coding agent 顺序调用编译、测试等耗时工具时会出现空闲停顿（observation stall），类似乱序处理器面临的顺序接口张力：可提前预测并启动的工作被隐藏，但推测结果必须在前序步骤验证后才可生效。

Method: TomasuLLM 乱序执行 agent 工具调用：预测未来动作，在隔离的 copy-on-write 沙箱中运行，追踪依赖与副作用，待与已提交状态验证后按轨迹顺序提交结果。

Result: 在三种基准上提升报告均值并随工具延迟扩展：SWE-bench Verified(100任务) 1.31x、Terminal-Bench 2.0(28任务) 1.35x、SWE-Marathon(18会话) 1.27x 匹配进度；4010 条提交验证记录零误接受。

Conclusion: 通过推测式乱序执行长耗时工具调用可有效缩短 agent 延迟，且严格提交验证保证任务执行正确性、无误接受。

Abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.
  We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.

</details>


### [192] [Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38203)
*Bahman Mirheidari,Leslie Ing,Daniel Blackburn,Sharon Abrahams,Christopher McDermott,Heidi Christensen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个自动化系统，利用ASR(WhisperX)与VAD(Silero)及精细化时间戳，从运动神经元病(MND)患者语音中估计言语流畅性指数(VFI)，最佳模型表现优异（P-words: R² 0.9；S-words: R² 0.8）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MND患者常伴言语障碍，使得认知障碍(CI)监测困难；ECAS是评估CI的稳健工具，其中VFI是核心指标，因此需要自动化估计VFI以支持及时诊疗。

Method: 基于独特的MND数据集，结合WhisperX(ASR)、Silero(VAD)与精细化时间戳，预测VFI并提取多个具临床可解释性的特征，与基于传统声学特征及自监督嵌入的系统进行比较，使用多种回归算法评估。

Result: 所提方法优于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入方法；临床启发式特征始终表现最佳，最佳模型P-words达R² 0.9、NRMSE 0.05，S-words达R² 0.8、NRMSE 0.08。

Conclusion: 结果表明自动化VFI估计具有可行性，为MND患者认知障碍监测提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

</details>


### [193] [The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38205)
*Muhammad Usama,Dong Eui Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究用CKA分析17个指令微调模型在20种系统提示下的层级表征，发现系统提示对模型内部计算的影响是层级选择性的：人设和格式指令深度重构中间表征，而安全指令几乎不改变计算路径，仅被"看到"而未被"执行"，从机制上解释了基于系统提示的安全防护为何易被越狱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统提示是控制语言模型行为的主要手段，但其对transformer内部计算的实际作用尚不清楚。

Method: 使用中心核对齐（CKA）比较17个指令微调模型（8个架构家族、1.5B-72B）在5类共20种系统提示下的逐层表征；辅以线性探针定位机制，并用因果激活修补验证关键层是否介导行为变化。

Result: 效果呈层级选择性和指令类型依赖：人设与格式指令深度重构中间表征，安全指令几乎不产生影响（与最小基线无统计差异）。限制性与明确允许性安全指令激活近乎相同的计算路径（平均CKA相关0.997），该现象在商用规模下持续存在，安全渗透率即使70B-72B也低于10%。探针显示模型在每层都编码提示类别但仅在小部分层重构计算。表征深度可预测行为效应大小（Spearman rho=0.761, p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 系统提示（尤其安全类）常被模型"看到"却未被"深入执行"，从机制层面解释了基于系统提示的安全防护持久的越狱脆弱性。

Abstract: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka

</details>


### [194] [TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38219)
*Mohamed-Amine Chadi,Ezzahra Ait El Arbi,Ismail Khayoub,Aymane Fadili,Yassine Ennhili,Jadjigua Bouali,Hanane Inhid,Mohammed Ameksa,Hajar Mousannif*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 TutlAit 数据集，一个带地域口音标签的摩洛哥塔马齐格特语语音语料库，含13,384个音频文件（约20.9小时，3.01GB），配套现代标准阿拉伯语文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 塔马齐格特语是摩洛哥官方语言之一，但语音技术资源严重匮乏：公开标注音频稀缺、缺乏地域变体信息、转写质量参差不齐。

Method: 通过自建众包Web应用（React 18前端、Django 5后端、PostgreSQL）收集数据。母语者注册后声明地域变体与人口信息，通过"文本到音频"和"音频到文本"两种流程贡献。另从公开音视频媒体经ELAN标注、CSV/ZIP批量导入补充。上传音频统一转16kHz单声道WAV、SHA-256去重、时长校验并由管理员审核。

Result: 数据集含13,384个音频文件，共75,231秒（约20.9小时，约3.01GB）。Atlas变体9,956个文件（14.08h），Souss变体3,378个文件（6.75h），另有小幅Rif（22）和Kabyle（28）子集。

Conclusion: 该语料库可用于摩洛哥塔马齐格特语的语音识别、语音翻译和口音识别研究。

Abstract: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

</details>


### [195] [Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38222)
*Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将split-conformal claim过滤应用于多跳RAG，验证其在多跳场景下的有效性，同时揭示可靠性提升以极低保留率和大量弃答为代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG的检索上下文不保证生成断言有事实支持，多跳RAG中检索与推理经多个依赖阶段，问题更突出。作者研究此前针对RAG的claim-level conformal factuality control在多跳场景是否仍有效。

Method: 将split-conformal claim filtering应用于多跳RAG，在HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA上评估，使用Llama 3.1 8B和GPT-4o-mini，并设单跳参照实验。

Result: 六个多跳模型-数据集配置中，越严格的目标越能提高保留断言完全被支持的应答比例。95%目标下该比例为95.80%-97.20%，无过滤时为55.60%-76.03%；但仅4.41%-31.09%的生成断言被保留，9.70%-51.40%的应答非空。

Conclusion: conformal factuality可扩展到多跳RAG，但名义可靠性须与断言保留率和弃答率联合解读。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.

</details>


### [196] [Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38256)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Michael Jacobs,Nils Metternich,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"意识形态模仿"现象：LLM的政治立场会随用户交互中的措辞和信号系统性偏移，而非固定属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估将LLM对争议政治议题的立场视为稳定属性，但真实用户通过术语、假设和个人背景传递政治信号，可能诱发模型立场向用户偏移，从而制造个性化政治信息环境、加剧分化。

Method: 构建Poli-SHIFT数据集与评估框架，针对美、英、澳十项争议政治议题，选取七个开源权重LLM，系统操纵争议术语、政治倾向性前提及用户信息，并采用多选题与开放文本两种形式采集回答。

Result: 跨模型发现提示框架稳健地影响政治立场：仅改变术语即可在16.9%的匹配比较中逆转模型所支持的一方；用户自述政治意识形态也使回答系统性偏向用户立场。

Conclusion: 政治立场并非LLM的固定属性，而是随与用户交互而条件性变化；在LLM日益个性化的背景下，这种交互依赖的适应可能强化用户既有观点，加剧政治信息环境的分化。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.

</details>


### [197] [ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38260)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出ContextAdapt评估框架，检验LLM能否在不同专业情境下恰当地应用诚实、自主、保密等价值，并保持对情境无关变化的稳定性。评估12个模型后发现：总体合适性高(95.6%)，但正确使用领域特定理由的比例差异大(25.6%–76.9%)；点名专业领域与改变模型角色影响有限，而改变利害程度会引发局部严重失误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 诚实、自主、保密等常被视为支撑AI对齐的通用原则，但其具体含义依赖决策情境。论文关注LLM是否能随专业情境调整价值应用，同时在情境变化不影响相关专业规范时保持一致。

Method: 构建ContextAdapt评估框架，覆盖医学、法律、金融、国家安全四个领域下的诚实、自主、保密三类价值。依据专业与监管一手文件建立"价值×领域"框架，设计测试默认专业规则与公认例外的情境。评估12个LLM，考察其推荐行为与给出的理由。主实验之外另设因子实验，操纵专业领域命名、模型角色与利害程度。

Result: 主实验中模型平均合适性达95.6%，但正确使用领域特定理由的比例在25.6%至76.9%之间差异很大。因子实验中，明确点名专业领域与改变模型角色对行为影响有限；改变利害程度则暴露严重但局部的失败：某些情况下专业义务未变，模型却改变回答。可感知的严重程度似乎成为诚实与保密情境中"披露"的线索。

Conclusion: 评估价值对齐不能只看模型是否遵循抽象原则，还须看它们能否在不同情境中恰当应用这些原则。仅靠抽象价值对齐评估会掩盖情境化应用中的关键缺陷。

Abstract: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

</details>


### [198] [NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38261)
*Takanori Kotama,Shun-ichiro Hayashi,Daichi Mukunoki,Tetsuya Hoshino,Takahiro Katagiri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NinaXander 用单个共享潜空间适配器连接不同架构家族的冻结语言模型层，实现事后组合；在 RWKV-4-Raven-7B 与 Tulu-Pythia-6.9b 上测试显示部分配置可大幅减少 KV 缓存，但整体性能难敌父模型且泛化下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究来自不同架构家族的冻结模型能否在训练后（post hoc）直接重组，即用少量适配器将不同模型的层拼接起来，从而复用已有模型能力。

Method: 提出 NinaXander：运行一个模型的前若干层，用单一训练的共享潜空间适配器转换中间表示，再运行另一模型的后若干层。适配器训练一次后，不同层连接的多种组合模型无需重训即可获得。用循环模型 RWKV-4-Raven-7B 与 Transformer 模型 Tulu-Pythia-6.9b 进行实验，评估选择题与语言建模。

Result: 组合模型生成文本语法通顺。Pythia 前 5 层加 RWKV 后 27 层的配置将 Transformer KV 缓存减少 84.4%，准确率与单独 RWKV 无显著差异。但选择题准确率均不及父模型 Pythia；在训练域外的 WikiText 上语言建模性能急剧下降。中间表示对应仅在共享分词器、相同深度和相同隐藏宽度的有利情况下获得。

Conclusion: 事后跨家族模型重组可以部分有效并显著节省 KV 缓存，但无法证明模型共享通用语义空间，性能总体不及父模型，跨域泛化能力明显不足。

Abstract: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

</details>


### [199] [Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38274)
*Liangyu Teng,Hengsong Liu,Juncen Guo,Jingyu Zhang,Yang Liu,Jing Liu,Liang Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出异质性驱动的LLM团队选择框架，通过可计算、可解释、可优化的互补性指标与贪心搜索优化团队组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM团队性能不仅受个体模型能力限制，还受成员间错误共振与预测差异影响。现有异构组队缺乏可计算、可解释、可优化的互补性指标，团队构成依赖启发式。

Method: 离线画像刻画个体能力，并引入两个互补信号：错误模式去相关（减少共同失败）和预测行为分歧（捕捉策略多样性）。将团队选择建模为标准化的质量-互补性组合优化目标，用高效贪心搜索从候选池中选小团队。

Result: 在多个基准上，于受控候选池与团队规模下，持续优于仅考虑质量的基线方法。

Conclusion: 为多LLM系统建立了可复用的团队选择原则。

Abstract: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. Although heterogeneous teaming is often observed to be effective in practice, existing approaches lack complementarity metrics that are computable, interpretable, and optimizable, leaving team composition to rely on heuristics. We propose a heterogeneity-driven team selection framework that performs offline profiling to characterize individual capability along with two complementary signals: one captures decorrelation in error patterns to reduce co-failures, while the other measures divergence in predictive behavior to capture strategy diversity. We formulate team selection as a standardized quality--complementarity combinatorial objective and apply an efficient greedy search to select a small team from a candidate pool. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms quality-only baselines under controlled candidate pools and team sizes, establishing reusable selection principles for multi-LLM systems.

</details>


### [200] [RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39045)
*Wenyi Wu,Minghao Fu,Jieyu You,Kun Zhou,Siqi Liu,Aayush Salvi,Yiheng Lin,Ce Zhang,Xiaohan Lan,Jiahui Zhu,Yujie Zhong,Qi She,Biwei Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RSIGame，一个具有递归自我改进能力的自主游戏开发智能体框架，通过局部与全局双重循环机制提升生成游戏质量，并将成功经验内化到生成器模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型使自动游戏生成变得可行，但如何可靠地改进生成游戏、超越可玩版本仍具挑战。朴素迭代优化容易过拟合少量测试用例，产生脆弱、存在未解决bug、行为缺失且泛化性差的游戏。

Method: RSIGame将开发组织为互补的局部与全局循环：局部"探索-诊断-改进"循环广泛探索可执行游戏、诊断并优先排序问题、进行基于证据的修订，并维护持续积累的演化检查清单；全局循环跟踪整体质量、保留最佳检查点、检测长期开发中的饱和或退化。此外，通过训练将成功开发经验内化到生成器中。

Result: 在140个GameCraft-Bench任务、两个游戏引擎和五种生成器上，RSIGame在相同开发预算下持续提升游戏质量。经验内化使Qwen3.8-27B在Godot上达到61.38、在Phaser上达到58.53，超过GPT-5.5单次生成成绩，同时减少Qwen生成token达11倍。

Conclusion: RSIGame通过递归自我改进的双循环框架有效提升自动生成游戏的质量与泛化性，并通过经验内化显著提升小模型效率与表现。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

</details>


### [201] [EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38334)
*Yuhan Guo,Jinming Liu,Liang Xu,Ziqiang Li,Jianguo Huang,Zhicheng Wang,Hu Zhu,Qiuyu Chen,Yuntao Wei,Xin Jin,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 EVOKE，一种后训练方法，通过在固定状态下引入目标多样性来诱发 LLM 智能体内部预训练的世界知识，从而提升任务表现与未见环境泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在多步决策中难以迁移到未见环境。世界模型方法需额外训练且误差累积；而数字环境中 LLM 预训练已内化大量世界知识，问题实质从"获取"转为"诱发"。但常规后训练在单一目标下监督，易使策略依赖表层上下文习惯，缺乏诱发动机。

Method: EVOKE 在固定环境状态与交互历史的前提下，对同一批候选动作在多种替代目标下进行排序，迫使动作偏好随目标改变；依赖上下文习惯或单目标关联的策略无法正确排序，从而隐式诱发预训练世界知识用于决策。

Result: 在三种骨干模型与多类任务上评估，EVOKE 提升了任务性能、未见环境泛化性和数据效率；并通过受控分析探究增益来源。

Conclusion: 为通过直接决策监督来诱发内部化世界知识、实现可迁移动作提供了新视角。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

</details>


### [202] [Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38355)
*Aisha Alansari,Abdessalam Bouchekif,Ahmed Hasanaath,Salah Eddine Bekhouche,Malak Alkhorasani,Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem,Saad Ezzini,Hichem Telli,Hend Al-Khalifa,Muhammad Abdul-Mageed,Hadid Abdenour,Hamzah Luqman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍 HalluScoring 2026 共享任务，旨在评估阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核查在分布偏移下的泛化能力，共设 2 个任务、4 个子任务，13 支队伍参赛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核查面临泛化挑战（未见问题、未见 LLM 生成的回答），亟需标准化评测基准。

Method: 组织共享任务，基于 HalluScore 和 HalluTruthQA 两个阿拉伯语数据集。Task 1 为二元幻觉检测（子任务 1.1 泛化到未见问题，1.2 泛化到未见 LLM）；Task 2 在检测基础上还需从六个候选答案中识别正确事实（2.1 伊斯兰知识，2.2 通用知识）。

Result: 13 支队伍参赛，10 支提交系统描述论文。Task 1 获胜队伍 AUC-ROC 分别为 0.772 和 0.767；Task 2 在辅助评估下获胜队伍得分分别为 0.882（伊斯兰）和 0.857（通用）。

Conclusion: 结果表明在分布偏移下幻觉检测仍具挑战性，Task 2 相对更易取得高分。

Abstract: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.

</details>


### [203] [Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38357)
*Parisa Salmani,Peter R. Lewis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过长对话实验发现，模型单轮安全性强并不意味着在多轮持续对抗中可以保持安全：安全回复率随对话深度显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话安全评估多仅测试单轮有害提示，而真实系统需应对长期、自适应的多轮用户交互，可能低估实际风险。

Method: 评估3个开源指令微调模型、2个有害提示，在不同对话长度和随机种子下进行测试；由第二个语言模型扮演持续对抗用户，安全分类器判定每次回复是否安全。

Result: 所有模型-提示组合的首轮安全回复率为85%-100%，至第11轮降至38%-61%，至第101轮降至15%-44%；下降趋势跨模型稳定出现，远超常见多轮安全评估的短交互范围。

Conclusion: 强单轮安全性不能保证持续对抗交互中的安全，需要长时程评估及考虑跨轮风险累积的对话级防护措施。

Abstract: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

</details>


### [204] [Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38374)
*Chand Sahil Mansuri,Joel Zachariah,Sadamori Kojaku*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络将论文表示为 LoRA 适配器，使论文空间中的每个点（包括混合点）都对应一个可用自然语言提问与指令的 LLM，兼顾检索与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文向量空间支持相似检索与学科关系探索，也可通过向量运算混合生成新点以模拟组合式创新；但混合点往往代表尚无论文实现的想法，附近没有论文可供识别。

Method: 用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络为每篇论文生成 LoRA 适配器，使空间中的点（含混合点）都对应一个 LLM，可用自然语言提问和下达指令；并引入小型可逆变换使嵌入具备检索竞争力且能映射回 LLM。

Result: 在 APS 论文上，于各子领域平均点让 LLM 用几个词命名领域，所得标签在词重叠和五位 LLM 评审下比五个基线更接近官方名称；在两篇 APS 论文之间的点提问可生成随混合权重从一篇向另一篇过渡的摘要；嵌入检索性能与 SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma 相当，接近 SBERT。

Conclusion: 该嵌入同时服务于检索与生成，研究者可把空间中任意点的想法作为生成新想法的起点进行提问。

Abstract: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

</details>


### [205] [Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38406)
*Eftekhar Hossain,John Salvador,Santu Karmaker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出约9.2K实例的多领域叙事填空基准，评估20个开源LLM（1.5B-70B），发现模型规模不能可靠预测填空质量，Gemma-2-2B以4.02/5最高分超越更大模型，显式推理仅带来+0.6%边际提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中信息噪声大且碎片化，从碎片重建连贯叙事需要文本填空。尽管许多LLM用填空作为预训练目标，但其在真实叙事填空上的表现仍缺乏探究，本文填补这一空白。

Method: 构建覆盖四类叙事（百科文本、常识故事、新闻、视觉叙事）的多领域基准，掩码1-3个句子，针对不同指令具体度与推理引导，用标准自动指标和涵盖五个叙事维度的定性框架评估20个指令微调开源LLM。

Result: 模型规模不能可靠预测填空质量：Gemma-2-2B定性得分最高（4.02/5），超过十倍大的DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.77/5）和LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.71/5）。显式推理收益有限，思维链仅+0.6%。短叙事和领域特征比填空位置更能预测任务难度。

Conclusion: 叙事填空质量不取决于模型规模，显式推理帮助有限；短叙事和领域特征是更强难度预测因子，为LLM叙事填空能力提供新认识。

Abstract: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.

</details>


### [206] [Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38427)
*Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez,Mumin Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出当前AI检测工具的目标（判断文本是否由AI撰写）与会议/期刊真正需要做的决策（判断人-AI工作流是否遵守既定政策）不匹配，提出"政策条件下的AI使用检测"框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 各大出版场所已针对作者、审稿人、领域主席等不同角色出台差异化AI使用规则，且披露要求各异。而用于执行这些规则的AI检测工具，实际估计的是"文本是否由AI模型撰写"，这一目标与会议/期刊面临的合规决策相脱节。

Method: 提出"政策条件下的AI使用检测"（policy-conditioned AI-use detection）作为证据框架：将政策作为显式输入；推断输出假设、证据、校准机制与不确定性，而非"检测到AI"式结论；用可复现流程构建合规/不合规工作流基准，并按场所预先设定的假阳性率报告真阳性率。

Result: 以同行评审为例：在合理的违规率下，即使检测器处于较强工作点，被标记的合规作者仍多于违规者。

Conclusion: 该框架明确了场所必须配备的要素：结构化披露、尊重审稿人保密性的受批工具路由、以及可对检测结论提出异议的申诉路径。在此视角下，检测器不是作者身份分类器，而是误差率由场所预先设定且可辩护的可审计程序。

Abstract: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

</details>


### [207] [The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38469)
*Nusrat Jahan Lia,Shubhashis Roy Dipta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 BACKDROP 基准，在保持任务指令与正确终态不变的前提下，向智能体执行环境中植入四类日常风险（权威、注入、越界、故障），以衡量"干净环境"能力在真实多人干扰环境中的存活率。3,678 个变体、16 个模型上，平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%，且最强模型跌幅最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准测试的环境是"静止"的，而实际部署的智能体所处的世界会被他人修改：可能收到要求转账的短信、被订单确认诱导回复门禁码等。因此需要衡量智能体在"他人也在改变的世界"中能力还剩多少。

Method: BACKDROP 接收任务及其执行环境，在不改变指令和正确终态的情况下，逐个及同时植入四类风险，每类对应一个核心问题：Authority（他人消息是否覆盖用户意图）、Injection（记录中植入文本是否使智能体转向）、Boundary（请求是否把智能体拉入未被授权的应用）、Fault（写入失败且未告知结果时，智能体是否先检查再重试）。共构造 3,678 个变体，测试 16 个模型。

Result: 四类风险全部出现时，平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强模型下降最多（Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%）。智能体已较能抵御注入文本，但常服从他人的其他未授权请求。在植入文本到达智能体的运行中，46.4% 遵循了他人消息，20.3% 遵循了注入文本，该差距在全部 16 个模型中一致存在。

Conclusion: BACKDROP 形式化了这些能力缺口，说明智能体在任务环境中的得分是其在真实世界表现的"上限"，真实部署场景下的可靠性被显著高估。

Abstract: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

</details>


### [208] [KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38480)
*Xueting Fang,Zehui Li,Yang Yang,Camilla Giovino,Shubh K. Patel,Shailly Prajapati,Vallijah Subasri,Caihua Shan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 KlinikeBench，一个由临床医生编写的 333 项任务基准，用于评估语言模型在完整临床问诊流程（病史采集、检查申请、约束遵守、最终诊断）中的表现，而非仅评估诊断准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床基准多用完整病例描述来评估模型诊断能力，但真实临床中医生需主动采集病史并决定检查项目，仅凭诊断准确率无法反映信息收集与临床评估过程是否恰当，且现有基准缺少专业临床医生的验证。

Method: 构建 KlinikeBench：333 个临床医生撰写的任务，每个任务包含隔离沙盒环境、虚拟患者、临床工具和任务专属成功标准；35 位以上临床医生参与病例撰写与基准评估。模型在固定回合预算内与患者对话、询问病史、申请检查、遵守行动约束并给出最终诊断，各步骤分别评分及综合评分。

Result: 在 31 个模型、7 个模型家族上的评测显示，最佳模型（如 GPT-6-astra、Claude Opus 5）任务成功率不足 30%，尽管其诊断准确率达 90.7%。部分模型从对话中获益，另一些在完整病历上诊断良好但对话中表现显著下降。临床医生对模拟对话的质量评分高于真实对话改编的参考对话。

Conclusion: KlinikeBench 为评估完整临床问诊提供了测试平台，揭示了诊断准确率与交互式临床评估表现之间的巨大差距。

Abstract: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

</details>


### [209] [Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38490)
*Maryam Haghifam,Zahra Rajabi,Yizhou Sun,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 STAM，一种状态转换感知的记忆框架，通过记录临床记录的状态变化来管理 LLM 代理记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 代理在推理临床记录时需追踪患者状态变化并保留历史。单纯累积记忆会难以判断哪些信息仍适用，而覆盖旧记忆则会抹去重建治疗史所需的证据。

Method: STAM 在新临床条目到达时记录状态变化，结合语义检索与类型化临床关系识别受影响的记忆，将当前信息存于 Active，被取代或已解决的信息存于 History；读取时通过查询相关的门控机制选择性提供历史记忆。

Result: 在四个纵向临床基准上，通过下游问答、直接状态维护诊断以及在近似匹配的上下文长度下进行比较来评估 STAM。

Conclusion: STAM 有效平衡了追踪当前患者状态与保留历史证据的需求，在临床纵向记忆任务中通过多项评估进行了验证。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

</details>


### [210] [DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38510)
*Longxuan Yu,Bingsen Chen,Peng Shi,Dongkyu Lee,Yi Xiang,Hideo Kobayashi,Sheng Zhang,Shuaichen Chang,Xing Niu,Zhuoyan Xu,Greg Ver Steeg,Jiarong Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DEdit：一种基于扩散的草稿器，支持迭代编辑草稿，通过token-to-token预测让后续预测作为双向上下文修复早期错误，配合ProposalMix训练方案，在多个基准上实现最高接受率与加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散草稿器可并行一次生成多token，但这些token独立预测，单个早期错误会导致前缀验证丢弃整个草稿，浪费了其中有用的下游预测。

Method: 提出DEdit，既能并行解掩码草稿，又能通过token-to-token预测迭代编辑草稿，使后续预测作为双向上下文修复早期错误。并提出ProposalMix训练方案，根据首轮置信度将草稿预测与真值token混合，让模型学会在保留正确预测的同时修复错误。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B的七个基准上，DEdit取得最高宏平均token接受率和加速比，贪心解码下分别达5.72倍和5.97倍加速。分析显示接受率随编辑轮次和草稿窗口增大而提升，ProposalMix将缩短接受前缀的有害编辑减半；限制编辑器为因果注意力会降低接受率，尤其在高度可预测输出上。

Conclusion: 通过迭代编辑实现双向修复的DEdit显著提升扩散草稿的接受率与推理加速，未来上下文信息是性能提升的关键来源，ProposalMix能有效减少有害编辑。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.

</details>


### [211] [TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38861)
*Sachin Gupta,Divya Godara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 TRACE 系统解决"grounding contract gap"（检索到相关论文 ≠ 生成可验证答案），在 LitTraceQA 基准的官方 71 题测试集上取得 0.760613 总分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 找到相关论文不等于能从中得出可验证答案。LitTraceQA 要求规范论文标识、页面/对象级精确证据以及与评测器匹配的类型化答案，源访问与评分可见正确性之间存在"grounding contract gap"。

Method: TRACE 采用目标分组检索、独立类型化证据定位、多模态表格抽取、schema 驱动表格构建及 fail-closed 校验；通过 passage、object、alias、citation、dense 多表示索引 27,487 篇论文并保留问题目标；表格先预测观测单元再抽值，按评测器兼容的键归一化组行。

Result: 官方 71 题测试集得分 0.760613：论文 F1 0.9728、证据 F1 0.6847、多选准确率 0.9800、表行 F1 0.5423、macro cell 准确率 0.3508。11 条公开开发集表格记录上，基线行 F1 0.291、坐标感知视觉填充 0.411（含 fallback，非官方测试结论）。

Conclusion: 剩余错误主要集中于定位符、观测单元、行键与源值身份识别，即答案与证据在细粒度身份层面的对齐问题。

Abstract: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.

</details>


### [212] [Shifting Mechanisms: How Positional Encoding Choice Shapes In-Context Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38530)
*Eric Enouen,Sainyam Galhotra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从机制角度研究位置编码(PE)选择如何影响语言模型的上下文检索，发现PE混合架构使模型从位置检索转向语义检索，并揭示长上下文增益背后的检索权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型越来越多在不同层使用不同的注意力跨度与位置编码（如滑动窗口注意力配RoPE、全局注意力配NoPE），但这些选择如何塑造上下文检索能力尚不清楚。

Method: 采用机制可解释视角，追踪PE选择如何塑造模型内部检索机制；分析22个开放权重模型（跨8个家族）；并进行受控预训练消融实验，将位置编码限制在局部层。

Result: 标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而PE混合模型转向语义检索；仅将PE限制在局部层即可产生这种语义偏移并削弱位置信息表示；SWA NoPE在多目标检索和QA上优于RoPE，但在区分竞争键时性能下降。

Conclusion: PE混合架构的长上下文增益掩盖了检索权衡，其行为差异更好地反映了从位置到语义机制的转变，而非长上下文检索的统一提升。

Abstract: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.

</details>


### [213] [Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39013)
*Divya Godara,Sachin Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EVICALC 在 DocSem 任务官方测试中实现 8.61% 联合准确率，公开验证集达 92.17% 答案准确率与 1.00 证据 F1，但两者配置不同、不可直接比较；文中通过描述性案例分析探讨失败原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与 DocSem 共享任务，构建能从 PDF 文档中读取内容、定位证据段落并进行算术推理的问答系统。

Method: 系统读取 PDF，选定 passge，让语言模型生成算术表达式并在本地代码中求值；保存中间结果以供故障检查。另对 100 份文档进行页面图像阅读的探索性研究。

Result: 官方最终测试 1,730 项任务联合准确率 8.61%；公开验证集答案准确率 92.17%、证据 F1 为 1.00。100 份文档的图像阅读研究中仅 22 份返回证据标识。

Conclusion: 描述性发现（如 OCR 与块分组错误导致证据合并、系统从不相关文本作答）仅用于启发后续评估，不能据此推断总体得分的成因。

Abstract: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.

</details>


### [214] [MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38543)
*Lukas Thede,Yash Kumar Atri,David Chen,Danielle Bitterman,Matthias Bethge,Tom Hartvigsen,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MedKIT基准，评估医学LLM知识整合与迁移能力，发现召回与可用知识之间存在持续差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实知识（尤其医学临床证据）不断演变，模型需持续更新。现有评估聚焦事实召回，无法反映新整合知识是否真正可用。

Method: MedKIT对模型在真实临床更新序列下的知识整合与应用进行细粒度评估。每个实例包含源自临床证据的事实更新，配以探测任务：词汇变体、关系变换、组合推理、开放式操作化及局部性知识保持测试。对12种知识整合策略、5个模型（通用与医学LLM）进行大规模实证研究。

Result: 召回与可用知识存在一致性差距：多数方法在原更新任务和词汇变体上提升显著，但关系泛化有限；在组合与操作任务上无方法取得有意义的改进。

Conclusion: 知识整合存在根本性挑战，MedKIT可作为开发使新整合知识在不同任务与情境中更一致可用的方法的测试平台。

Abstract: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.

</details>


### [215] [Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39225)
*Siddharth Bhargava,Sara Tonelli,Patricia Martín-Rodilla,Javier Parapar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估对话场景下的论辩结构预测(ASP),比较监督微调与提示式LLM在单步/多步架构下的表现,发现论辩关系识别是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ASP研究虽探索了统一神经模型、多步流水线和LLM等多种方法,但其相对权衡尚不清晰,尤其是对话场景下缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 在严格schema约束下,对监督微调和提示式LLM进行系统对比,涵盖单步与多步任务架构,端到端从对话输入生成完整论辩结构;在三个改编自Inference Anchoring Theory的对话语料上,采用统一框架评估预测性能、跨域泛化、schema合规性和计算效率。

Result: ASP仍是困难任务,识别论辩关系是主要瓶颈,根源在于对话论辩的隐式与上下文依赖特性。

Conclusion: 为促进后续研究,作者发布了数据处理流水线及面向对话语料的端到端ASP建模框架。

Abstract: Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings.
  We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.

</details>


### [216] [Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38593)
*Bo Ni,Li Li,Ryan A. Rossi,Franck Dernoncourt,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Prompt2Skill框架，仅凭自然语言任务描述即可构建并迭代优化技能，无需人工编写或精选训练集，在四个领域平均提升10.8分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家编写的技能成本高且未针对具体消费模型优化（失败模式随版本、规模、训练变化而变化）；新兴任务可能超出已有技能库范围；现有自动技能优化方法依赖精选的同分布训练集，用户往往不具备。

Method: Prompt2Skill仅以自然语言任务描述为输入：从提示中推导任务规范，发现或合成数据集，再通过反思式编辑的闭环流程迭代精炼技能。

Result: 在问答、阅读理解、电子表格操作、数学推理四个领域，Prompt2Skill在开源与前沿模型上均稳定优于直接提示基线，平均提升10.8分。

Conclusion: 仅凭任务描述即可自动构建并优化技能，摆脱对人工技能编写与精选训练数据的依赖，为新兴任务提供可扩展的技能构建方案。

Abstract: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.

</details>


### [217] [Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39358)
*Sietse Schelpe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Galahad 是一个为 vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp 设计的记忆层，将已读文本的 KV 状态与文档缓存复用，把无状态推理变为有状态推理，大幅降低重复计算的开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 每 token 计算量有上限，且服务无状态：回答文档的第二个问题时需从头重算 attention 状态。实测七个数据集中 98.7% 的 prompt token 是模型已读过的文本，造成大量重复计算与能耗浪费。

Method: Galahad 包含两个组件：Taliesin 保存文本块的 KV 状态，在下次遇到相同字节时直接加载而非重算；Blaise 保留文档本身，只向模型传入问题所需片段。集成于 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp，并采用失败关闭（fail-closed）机制，校验不通过则重算。

Result: 在 97,000 token 语料、100 条事实的召回测试（Gemma 4 31B）中，仅 Taliesin 在 llama.cpp 上答对 98/100，用时 3.0 s、572 J；无 Galahad 时仅 10/100、9.3 s、2,754 J。加上 Blaise 后每问约读 668 token，三个运行时均答对 100/100，0.59–0.64 s、200–213 J；RAGFlow 仅 77。缓存一次性成本约 100 s、28 kJ，13 个问题后即回收。状态恢复后 262,144 个输出 logits 完全一致。

Conclusion: Galahad 在测试的 30 个模型上均有效，验证了 KV 状态与文档复用可将 LLM 服务从无状态推理推进到有状态推理，在准确性、延迟和能耗上均获显著收益。

Abstract: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs.
