Method: 提出 ConflictGuide：其可复用 Skill 结合文献分类体系与模型特定证据，识别竞争行为并设计探针，由代码智能体实现为指标。两阶段演化——Stage I 用任务反馈探索；Stage II 用探针反馈引导提案缓解冲突，仅在探针显示缓解足够时保留边际增益编辑。

Result: 在五个不同模型家族上，相比仅用标量反馈的 AutoResearch，任务误差和冲突相关误差分别最多降低 28% 和 14%，且收益可迁移至其他代码智能体。

Conclusion: 显式引入竞争行为反馈可在任务增益递减时提升双目标改进比例，突破标量反馈的平台期，是一种通用且可迁移的 AutoResearch 增强方法。

Abstract: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.

</details>


### [434] [Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39955)
*Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RIGS两阶段框架，实现指令条件下的逆合成，让模型能按偏好选择前体集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单步逆合成只评估能否复现真实反应，无法体现"按化学家偏好（如保留特定结构）选择备选前体"的能力；这需要同时具备备选覆盖度与偏好控制力。

Method: RIGS分两阶段：Stage A训练语言投影器，学习指令偏好或排斥哪些备选；Stage B用该投影器通过轻量残差适配器引导冻结的生成模型。并构建嵌套的一对多训练支持集，为每个产物配对递增数量的候选前体集合。

Result: 实验表明更广的支持集有助于模型生成更多样的备选，RIGS能按指令引导生成；覆盖度与控制力的关系在不同模型规模下一致，但呈非单调性。

Conclusion: RIGS首次将指令条件引入逆合成，兼顾覆盖度与控制力，可为化学家依偏好选择前体提供支持。

Abstract: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. We construct nested one-to-many training supports by pairing each product with increasing numbers of candidate precursor sets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that broader support helps the model generate a wider range of alternatives, and RIGS can learn to guide generation according to instructions. The relationship between coverage and control is consistent across model scales but non-monotone.

</details>


### [435] [Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39958)
*Ludovic Gibert,Matis Despujols,Andre-Louis Rochet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文回顾性研究了一个结合27B语言模型、财务计算、叙事模板与验证检查的智能体框架，用于生成投行演示文稿，并探讨LLM评判分数是否反映文档质量还是评分标准变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投行团队制作演示文稿需整合财务数据、追溯来源并形成建议；同时，用LLM评判指导工程改动时，无法确定分数提升是文档更好还是评分变化。

Method: 采用27B语言模型，搭配财务计算、叙事模板和验证检查构建智能体框架；在共享会话、纯文本、去除模板标记的评分设置下，使用五个LLM评判员对完整系统与直接用短提示生成的输出进行打分。

Result: 五个评判员给完整系统打出20.4至33.6分（满分95）高于同模型直接生成；所有评判员在十七个开发交付物上均给系统更高分。与短提示直接使用Opus生成相比，差距在-4.7至+0.8分。评判员对开发轮次整体进展较一致，但对最终文稿排名一致性较低；重复评分即使文稿不变也会变动，使小改进难以与评判波动区分。

Conclusion: LLM评判显示该智能体框架总体优于短提示直接生成，但评判员一致性有限且重复评分不稳定，因此应谨慎解释分数提升，小改进难以可靠区分。

Abstract: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

</details>


### [436] [AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39964)
*Yijie Bian,Kai Zhang,Wei Guo,Zixin Wang,Shenghui Song,Jun Zhang,Khaled B. Letaief*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出智能体AI框架AIMS，用两个智能体协调场景构建与任务学习，实现多模态ISAC的仿真到现实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的多模态ISAC模型依赖大量标注真实数据，而合成数据方案在场景、感知、无线与学习配置不匹配时，仿真到现实迁移效果差。

Method: AIMS基于自然语言部署请求（任务、条件、真实数据预算）推导配置；采用双智能体架构：场景构建智能体从共享物理状态生成地理对齐的同步感知与无线记录，场景理解智能体配置任务相关模态与MoE学习（零样本推理或少样本适配）；用结构化领域知识引导依赖感知规划，用验证证据进行反馈修正。

Result: 在真实DeepSense 6G数据集上，车辆检测与波束预测优于所对比的仿真与融合基线；编排基准测试显示结构化领域知识与验证反馈提升了任务解释、依赖推理和重规划的计划正确性。

Conclusion: AIMS通过智能体化、知识引导与反馈驱动的仿真到现实框架，有效提升多模态ISAC的部署可扩展性与迁移性能。

Abstract: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

</details>


### [437] [What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39989)
*Shuyang Zhang,Jianshuo Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该批判性范围综述审视了组件替换对语言模型智能体任务级收益与局部决策质量贡献的归因问题，映射348项研究并详细分析90条对比记录，通过8个案例归纳出三类可能机制及8项针对具体主张的报告条目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在语言模型智能体中替换某个组件会改变执行轨迹，进而影响后续观察、资源使用和恢复机会；因此需要区分替换带来的任务级收益与局部决策质量本身的贡献，而现有研究往往无法厘清这一归因。

Method: 开展批判性范围综述，映射348项研究，考察90条对比记录（40项纳入研究提供88条，补充研究提供2条）；选取8个案例，围绕被替换决策、执行条件、测量可比性、对照设置及剩余解释进行结构化综合分析。

Result: 222项研究报告局部决策指标，其中142项同时报告实测任务终点、49项报告代理指标，但这些计数仅表明两类测量并存，未证明其来自匹配比较。三个案例分别显示：Outcome Monitors的包级完成增益难以归因于检测器质量；First-chunk selection以离线代理终点评估局部改进；Evidence-Carrying Termination减少过早无据终止且完成度非劣，但未证明更优。跨案例识别出恢复与干扰、干预时机、下游使用三类候选机制。

Conclusion: 综述区分了组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献，并提出8项针对具体主张的报告条目；仅凭在线执行或局部与任务指标同时提升，均不足以证明更好的局部决策解释了任务级增益。归因与部署取决于对照设置、标签定义及控制器可用信息。

Abstract: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use. Attribution and deployment depend on the comparison controls, label definitions, and information available to the controller. Conclusions. The review distinguishes the task-level benefit of a component replacement from the contribution of local decision quality and derives eight claim-specific reporting items. Neither online execution nor simultaneous gains in local and task metrics alone establish that better local decisions explain the task-level gain.

</details>


### [438] [Who Verifies the Graph? Misspecification Attacks on Causal Action Verification for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40027)
*Fabio Rovai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CIVeX因果动作验证器在混淆工具使用基准上报告零错误执行，但仅通过破坏承诺图即可被攻破；每项攻击都携带内部有效证书。一个针对有界随机样本的认证步骤可检测两种攻击，但无法恢复被错误拒绝的有益执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果动作验证器（如CIVeX）声称能通过检查每个干预是否相对承诺的动作-状态图可识别来保证安全性，并报告零错误执行。作者意在重新审视这一安全声明，探究验证器对承诺图本身错误设定的鲁棒性，并区分"错误行动"与"错误不作为"两类代价。

Method: 对CIVeX进行红队测试，仅破坏承诺图：一是省略一条双向边，二是反转一个箭头方向（把中介变量承诺为混淆变量）。再引入一个认证步骤，用有界随机样本检验每个观察上已认证的执行，拒绝未通过或无法检验的执行。

Result: 省略一条双向边使错误执行从0升至15.3%，其中91%有害，效用从+2.27降至+0.35；反转箭头方向导致48.9%错误执行且无一正确。所有攻击均携带内部有效证书。认证步骤检测出两种攻击，在诚实图上555次执行中仅2次误报；拒绝失败/不可测执行后所有设定下零错误执行。但它不恢复有益执行：发布强度下97.1%有益动作仍从未执行。恢复安全需每1,050动作127次实验，恢复价值还需614次。

Conclusion: 验证器的证书对承诺图错误设定并不鲁棒。仅审查执行的审计能防止错误行动，但错误不作为必须单独付出代价；其成本随拒绝数而非执行数增长。安全与价值恢复是彼此独立的问题。

Abstract: Causal action verifiers gate an agent's state-changing tool calls by checking whether each proposed intervention is identifiable against a committed action-state graph, and they issue a certificate that carries the identification argument and a one-sided lower confidence bound. One such verifier, CIVeX, reports zero false executions on a confounded tool-use benchmark. We red-team it by corrupting only the committed graph. Omitting a single bidirected edge takes it from zero false executions to 15.3% at the benchmark's published confounding strength, with 91% of its executions harmful and utility falling from +2.27 to +0.35. Reversing one arrowhead, so that a mediator is committed as a confounder, gives 48.9% false executions and no correct ones. Every one of these actions carries an internally valid certificate. An attestation step that tests each observationally certified execution against a bounded randomised sample detected both attacks, with 2 false alarms in 555 executions on a truthful graph; refusing what fails the test, or cannot be tested, gave zero false executions in every setting we measured. It does not restore beneficial execution: at the published strength 97.1% of beneficial actions are still never executed, because the same misspecification rejects them before attestation runs. Those rejections carry certificates too, and auditing them works, but its cost scales with the number of rejections rather than the number of executions. Recovering safety costs 127 experiments per 1,050 actions; recovering the lost value costs 614 more, at which point the audited verifier makes the honest graph's decisions on every instance and spends exactly its experiment budget. An audit that inspects only executions protects against wrongful action. Wrongful inaction has to be paid for separately.

</details>


### [439] [PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40090)
*Yubo Cao,Xi Deng,Mengqi Xia,Vignesh Gopakumar,Ander Gray,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PTNO神经算子，直接从含噪、低成本的蒙特卡洛标签学习粒子输运代理模型，在聚变中子输运与辐射传输任务上实现显著加速与降本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真蒙特卡洛模拟粒子输运需追踪海量粒子，成本极高；现有学习型代理依赖昂贵且良好收敛的MC解。直接用低成本含噪MC标签可摊薄成本，但面临高方差和高动态范围两大挑战。

Method: PTNO从多组态含噪标签学习解算子；利用MC标签无偏性证明其平方损失与收敛解损失共享极小值，并通过训练场景数M、每渲染采样数N、每场景独立渲染数K的预算分配研究确定最优组合。为应对HDR，保持物理空间标签，用softplus输出层保证正值并有效表达小值，采用逐点相对L2损失（PRelL2），以停止梯度预测而非含噪标签归一化残差。

Result: 在聚变反应堆中子输运与参与介质辐射传输上验证。两项中子学任务中，PTNO比同CPU收敛MC快10^4–10^5倍，在匹配精度下比MC便宜10^3–10^5倍；两项辐射传输任务中，匹配精度MC成本为PTNO的0.8–11倍。

Conclusion: 直接从含噪低成本MC标签学习神经算子是可行的，多而噪的场景优于少而收敛的场景，softplus与PRelL2能有效处理HDR与噪声，PTNO在粒子输运代理建模中实现大幅加速与成本降低。

Abstract: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.

</details>


### [440] [Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40111)
*Kunlun Zhu,Xuyan Ye,Yibo Li,Cheng Qian,Beibin Li,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Error Dataset (AED)及Agentic Error-to-Training (AET)流程，将失败的LLM agent rollouts转化为可复用的诊断与纠正训练数据，验证了错误纠正与诊断微调能显著提升agent恢复与诊断能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 失败的LLM agent rollout包含观察、动作和环境响应等丰富信息，但仅靠最终奖励无法充分利用。要实现经验复用学习，需识别待修正的决策并测试具体的替代方案。

Method: 构建AED数据集（50,228个错误诊断对，来自9,961个源任务、33个环境、19个harness家族、23个策略模型），保留源轨迹与执行元数据；设计五阶段AET流程：收集自然失败、生成诊断与纠正、对照记录证据检验，并在支持replay时以相同checkpoint和匹配设置比较纠正与原动作重试；随后分别为诊断和actor恢复构建训练视图。

Result: 在3,062对匹配replay中，首次提议纠正将验证器通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7个百分点）。在冻结诊断集微调中，Qwen3-8B在943例holdout上的exact-step agreement从47.2%升至63.6%，超过最强prompted reference的54.7%，且在四种训练规模下均有提升。单种子actor训练对比中，action-only repair在WebShop-lite上比success-only高6.67个百分点。

Conclusion: 失败经验可被系统化转化为诊断与纠正训练信号，AED与AET为跨环境、跨harness的agent错误分析与再诊断提供了可复用资源，并实证了错误驱动训练对诊断与恢复能力的有效性。

Abstract: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

</details>


### [441] [Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40115)
*Chandak Chakma,Syed Nazmus Sakib,Nafiul Haque,Shifat E. Arman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视RLVR中"难学提示"现象：这些提示实际仍在学习（约为可学速率1/3），但其难度标签定义不稳定、不可复现，且梯度相似性证据部分源于采样偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作认为部分困难提示在RLVR中无法学习，现有解释依赖难度定义的提示集合与梯度相似性证据，但这些测量本身可能不可靠，需重新检验。

Method: 提出基于采样的框架量化难度标签的不稳定性，评估可靠复现难度分配所需评测量；并重新检验梯度相似性证据，控制正确rollout数量（采样数）进行匹配分析。

Result: 所谓不可学提示实际以约可学速率三分之一的水平提升；难度定义集合跨种子组合会改变提示选择而不仅减少噪声，可复现性远低于预期；梯度差异部分来自困难提示正确rollout更少，匹配采样数后差异减弱但未消失。

Conclusion: 慢学习现象在重新分析后依然成立，但用于定义该现象的提示集合与解释它的证据都需要更严谨的测量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

</details>


### [442] [Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40169)
*Jingbo Yang,Kwei-Herng Lai,Xiaowen Wang,Yaar Harari,Evgeniy Gabrilovich,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ScholarEvolve框架，利用研究文献自动指导语言agent harness演化，在AppWorld和Tau2-Bench上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言agent需解决日益复杂的任务，需持续改进。现有方法用元编码agent基于执行反馈修改harness，但依赖其已有知识和观察到的失败，限制了探索且使适应变得被动。受人类专家从研究文献中学习新方案的启发，希望用最新研究指导harness演化。

Method: 将harness演化方向组织为功能模块，用主题建模为每个模块识别不同的改进策略；实现这些策略并评估其组合以提升任务表现；框架支持随时间纳入新出版物，实现主动的终身演化。

Result: 在AppWorld和Tau2-Bench上均有提升。AppWorld Challenge上Qwen3.5-27B任务目标完成率从49.6%升至63.6%；Tau2-Bench Telecom上GPT-5.4-mini pass@1从72.7%升至81.9%。

Conclusion: 通过自动整合前沿研究文献指导harness演化，可有效提升语言agent性能，并支持持续主动的终身进化。

Abstract: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

</details>


### [443] [Belief-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding under Map Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40269)
*Viraj Parimi,Shao-Hung Chan,Han Zhang,Jingkai Chen,Brian Williams*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAGIC是一个面向Belief-Aware MAPF的框架，利用高斯马尔可夫随机场与高斯信念传播在线更新共享可通行信念，构建绕行感知代价，实验在96.3%实例上降低执行总代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典MAPF假设静态障碍已知，但现实中障碍会因掉落物、洒漏等意外出现，且此类空间相关的改变可影响观测位置之外的可通行性估计。已有偶发规划或基于直接观测重规划的方法未利用空间依赖来推断邻近未观测区域，无法提前预判附近未观测障碍，导致后期高代价绕行。

Method: 提出MAGIC，基于agent在线观测更新共享可通行信念；采用高斯马尔可夫随机场建模空间相关性，用高斯信念传播近似推断可通行性，并为标准MAPF规划器构造detour-aware代价。

Result: 在MAPF基准测试中，MAGIC在96.3%的实例上相比现有方法降低执行总代价（sum of costs），覆盖多个规划器族及最多800个agent的团队，证明可扩展至大规模MAPF问题。

Conclusion: 通过在线信念推断利用空间相关性，MAGIC能提前预判未观测障碍并减少后续绕行，适用于大规模MAPF场景。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to find collision-free paths for multiple agents in a shared environment. Classical MAPF assumes that all static obstacles are known in advance, but real-world environments can change unexpectedly due to fallen objects, spills, or other local disturbances. When such changes are spatially correlated, an observation can inform traversability estimates beyond the observed location. Prior approaches address uncertainty in traversability through contingent plans or replanning based on direct observations, but do not leverage this spatial dependence to infer the traversability of nearby unobserved locations. As a result, they cannot use one observation to anticipate nearby unobserved obstacles that may cause costly rerouting later. We focus on Belief-Aware MAPF, where map discrepancies are fixed during execution but initially unknown, and observations can be informative beyond the observed location. We propose Multi-Agent Gaussian belief Inference for Coordination (MAGIC), a framework that updates a shared belief about traversability online based on agents' observations. MAGIC uses a Gaussian Markov Random Field and Gaussian Belief Propagation to approximately infer traversability and construct detour-aware costs for standard MAPF planners. Our experiments on MAPF benchmarks show that MAGIC reduces the executed sum of costs compared to existing approaches on 96.3% of instances, across several planner families and teams of up to 800 agents, demonstrating its applicability to large-scale MAPF problems.

</details>


### [444] [PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40285)
*Yinghui He,Yapei Chang,Khushi Bhardwaj,Daniele Molinari,Tugrul Konuk,Jan Kautz,Ali Hatamizadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PivotOPD，一种在线策略蒸馏框架，通过同时训练学生模型预防关键错误并从其造成的状态中恢复，缓解多轮交互中的误差累积问题，在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮交互中，一个错误动作会改变后续状态，导致误差跨轮累积。作者发现超过一半的失败轨迹存在一个早期出现的关键错误（pivotal mistake），但这些错误通常可以恢复。

Method: 在每个关键错误处，教师提供金动作，并在随后几轮命名恢复动作。预防蒸馏用逆KL引导学生远离关键错误；恢复蒸馏用前向KL传递学生难以采样的恢复行为。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-based QA 上对比13个基线，PivotOPD 对 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Qwen3-8B 均取得最强平均性能，1.7B 学生在 ALFWorld 上提升 +5.5%。在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，Nemotron-3.5 学生的解决率提升 +3.2%。

Conclusion: PivotOPD 通过预防与恢复的联合蒸馏有效缓解多轮误差累积，并可跨模型族和领域迁移。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/pivotopd/

</details>


### [445] [How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40303)
*Kirill Brilliantov,Alejandro Hernández-Cano,Emmanuel Abbé*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现，在相同时间预算与相同前沿LLM骨干下，开源SOTA的复杂MLE智能体框架相比仅含读写bash原语的最小化编码智能体基线并无优势，性能主要由骨干模型驱动，复杂框架层在编码智能体设定下趋于冗余。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主机器学习工程（MLE）智能体因长周期进展停滞与LLM原语受限，普遍堆叠多智能体编排器、专用检索子代理等复杂机制，而更原始但更强的编码智能体（LLM直接通过read/write/bash操作执行环境）却少被关注。

Method: 在相等时间预算与相同前沿LLM骨干条件下，将开源SOTA智能体框架与单会话最小化框架编码智能体基线进行对比，并开展大规模系统性消融实验，检验各机制层的必要性。

Result: 开源SOTA框架相对最小化编码智能体基线未提供任何优势；消融表明这些机制层在编码智能体设定下变得冗余。

Conclusion: 在强模型周围精心设计手工框架对当前MLE基准的回报很低，性能提升主要取决于骨干模型本身。

Abstract: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.

</details>


### [446] [WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40325)
*Ziyan Jiang,Jingbo Yang,Jiabao Ji,Yujian Liu,Qiucheng Wu,Tommi Jaakkola,Yang Zhang,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WorldAuditBench，用于评估多模态智能体在3D世界中审计异常（如悬浮物体、可穿墙）的能力，需耦合行动与视觉推理，但模型成功率远低于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式3D世界日益用于研究智能行为，需高效识别异常（悬浮物体、可穿墙、与场景不一致物体）。VLM/VLA虽有潜力，但3D世界审计需紧密耦合"行动导航搜索"与"视觉推理识别异常"两种能力，现有研究是否有效耦合仍未知。

Method: 构建WorldAuditBench基准：213个异常任务、13个环境（Unreal Engine 5与Three.js）、5类异常家族。在固定探索预算下，评估5个前沿模型，采用两种范式：VLA探索后VLM识别；以及端到端VLM智能体（视觉推理直接指导行动）。

Result: 两种范式下各模型成功率6.6%–42.3%，远低于人类83.4%。

Conclusion: WorldAuditBench为研究多模态智能体如何耦合行动与视觉推理提供测试平台，并揭示其在探索中收集与解读证据能力的当前局限。

Abstract: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

</details>


### [447] [Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40330)
*Tunyu Zhang,Hao Wang,Kai Xu,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Turbo Harness 通过复用全局 harness 优化过程中产生的信息，为每个任务实例生成定制化的 harness 补丁，实现实例级自适应，并在多类基准上超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 harness 优化通常只生成单一的全局 harness 并统一应用于所有任务，但平均表现好的 harness 未必对每个实例最优，因此需要实例级自适应。

Method: 回收已完成的全局 harness 优化运行中产生的工件，将其总结为结构化 playbook；训练一个 harness editor 利用该先验优化经验为全局 harness 生成实例特定补丁；推理时 editor 结合实例与 playbook 构建定制 harness 供执行模型使用。

Result: 在交互式智能体任务、软件工程和长时程终端任务等七项基准上，Turbo Harness 持续优于现有 harness 优化基线。

Conclusion: Turbo Harness 是一种可复用已有优化经验实现实例级 harness 自适应的框架，有助于推动智能体递归自我改进，并在广泛任务上展现出稳定优势。

Abstract: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [448] [TAGGRAPH: Tag-Augmented Graphs for Graph Retrieval of Agent Persistent Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38353)
*Yu-Su Chen,Yu-Jung Liang,Pengtao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控评估框架，基于共享的5W式对话记忆比较图记忆与词法检索。AdaptiveGraph在LongMemEval-S上MRR为0.844，但BM25（0.867）和OpenClaw（0.880）更强；ATANT Core上图遍历优于扩散与BM25。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆系统的表示、索引、检索和评估各异，难以公平比较；本文希望提供一个可控框架以隔离这些差异并公平评估检索策略。

Method: 构建共享基础图上的局部图配置与AdaptiveGraph（加入时间边和Personalized PageRank扩散），并在相同抽取笔记上评估BM25，以及以OpenClaw作原始输入外部参照。

Result: LongMemEval-S上AdaptiveGraph最强图配置为0.844 MRR，但BM25达0.867、OpenClaw 0.880；ATANT Core上局部图遍历优于扩散与BM25，压力轮次BM25领先；缩小存储未复现ATANT扩散惩罚，但最小存储仍大于ATANT Core；词表归一化与抽取质量显著影响图检索，前五遗漏常见缺抽取标签。

Conclusion: 检索策略应与记忆设置联合评估，并对标强词法基线；图记忆未必优于词法方法，抽取质量与归一化是关键。

Abstract: Long-term memory lets LLM agents recall past interactions and remain consistent across sessions, but memory systems are hard to compare because they often vary in representation, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation. We present a controlled evaluation framework based on shared 5W-style conversational memories. Localized graph configurations traverse a common base graph; AdaptiveGraph adds chronological edges and Personalized PageRank diffusion. We also evaluate BM25 over the same extracted notes and OpenClaw as a raw-input external reference. Retrieval rankings vary across memory settings. On LongMemEval-S, AdaptiveGraph is the strongest graph configuration at 0.844 MRR, but BM25 reaches 0.867 and OpenClaw 0.880. On ATANT Core, localized graph traversal outperforms diffusion and BM25, whereas BM25 leads the stress rounds. Reducing LongMemEval-S within the tested range does not reproduce the ATANT diffusion penalty, but the smallest tested store remains larger than ATANT Core, so store size cannot be ruled out. The penalty also persists under a permissive content-match criterion. Vocabulary normalization and extraction quality substantially affect graph retrieval, and missing extraction tags are common among top-five misses. Retrieval strategies should therefore be evaluated jointly with the memory setting and against strong lexical baselines.

</details>


### [449] [AdaM-Rec: Adaptive Modality Routing for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38455)
*Honghao Fu,Jiacheng Chen,Manxi Lin,Junjun Zheng,Xiangheng Kong,Yiwei Wang,Xin Yu,Miao Xu,Yuning Jiang,Yujun Cai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出AdaM-Rec，一个基于LLM的自适应模态路由框架，用代理召回任务动态校准多模态推荐中对文本与多模态证据的依赖，性能超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法多采用静态模态融合，假设文本与视觉信号的相对重要性在各推荐场景中保持稳定。然而不同查询对模态的需求各异：有些需要细粒度视觉线索，有些更适合文本或功能语义。不加区分地融合会引入无用线索，损害推荐质量。

Method: 基于结构化的自然语言物品与用户偏好表示，通过代理召回任务估计模态可靠性：生成与实际查询粒度匹配的伪查询，指向用户正向交互物品作为可验证代理目标，评估哪种模态在类似场景下召回更优，并以智能体方式优化路由策略。随后按优化策略执行路由召回，用协同物品丰富结果，并依据与查询及用户偏好的相关性对候选进行排序。

Result: 实验表明AdaM-Rec相比最先进基线取得强劲性能，验证了多模态推荐中自适应控制模态依赖的有效性与更广泛潜力。

Conclusion: 自适应模态路由能有效提升多模态推荐质量，彰显对模态依赖进行动态控制的价值与前景。

Abstract: While recent multimodal recommender systems have demonstrated the effectiveness of incorporating visual and textual information to improve downstream performance, most existing methods rely on static modality fusion, assuming that the relative importance of textual and visual signals remains stable across recommendation scenarios. This design may not fully account for an important variation across recommendation requests: some queries require fine-grained visual cues, whereas others are better served by textual or functional semantics, in which case indiscriminate modality fusion brings in uninformative cues and impairs recommendation quality. To address this, we propose AdaM-Rec, an LLM-based framework for adaptive modality routing in multimodal recommendation, which enables dynamic calibration of reliance on textual and multimodal evidence for user-specific queries. Built on structured natural-language representations of items and user preferences, it estimates modality reliability using proxy recall tasks. Specifically, it generates pseudo-queries that match the granularity of the actual query while pointing to the user's positively interacted items as verifiable proxy targets, evaluating which modality yields better recall performance in analogous scenarios and optimizing the routing strategy in an agentic manner. It then performs routed recall with optimized strategy, enriches results with collaborative items, and ranks candidates by their relevance to both the query and user preferences. Experiments demonstrate that AdaM-Rec delivers strong performance against state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness and broader potential of adaptive control over modality reliance in multimodal recommendation.

</details>


### [450] [Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38473)
*Bhagyesh Rathi,Eshan Chawla,William B. Andreopoulos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对科学问答中的六种RAG检索策略进行了受控对比，基于46万篇arXiv论文和近2万合成问题，提供开源测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG已成为LLM外部知识落地的主流方式，但检索管线设计空间大、变体间权衡不清，尤其在真实规模的领域语料上缺乏理解。

Method: 对六种检索策略进行受控比较：top-k稠密检索、LLM查询改写、改写+LLM重排、RRF多查询融合、生成器自主决策的agentic工具调用、ColBERTv2后交互检索。共享相同的生成器(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct)、提示和评估协议，五个单向量管线共用SPECTER2嵌入和Chroma向量库，语料为463,971篇2024-2025年arXiv论文。

Result: 发布由Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct从1万篇论文生成的19,484个合成问题数据集(成功9,742篇)，所有策略在同一查询集上评估，采用LLM-as-a-judge多维度质量评估及金标准论文检索指标。

Conclusion: 构建了一个开放测试平台，用于研究研究文献语料上RAG设计的成本-质量权衡，并为忠实性、检索鲁棒性和agentic检索的未来工作奠定基础。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

</details>


### [451] [Exploring Forum Post Retrieval with Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38646)
*Yang Li,Yaguang Liu,Heng Liu,Shengbo Guo,Samson Komo,Jane Kou,Yulian Zhou,Gang Yang,Shubhojeet Sarkar,Gaurav Chakravorty,Yujie Liu,Haipeng Chen,Yonghuan Yang,Deepti Chheda,Yamin Wang,Mike Plumpe,Rish Tandon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究在 Facebook Groups 的新独立应用 Forum 上部署生成式推荐（GR），通过跨语料迁移和跨平台复用语义 ID（SID）解决数据稀疏问题，并用 3B 指令微调语言模型直接从用户上下文生成 SID，系统消融了关键设计选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Forum 是一个新的独立表面，自身交互数据过于稀疏，无法从零训练 GR 模型；因此需要探索如何将生成式推荐迁移到该新推荐场景。

Method: 沿两个轴迁移：1）训练数据从 Forum 会话扩展到更广的 Facebook Groups 互动语料；2）复用从跨平台 Facebook Feed 数据学习的分层、基于前缀的语义 ID，而非拟合 Forum 专属 tokenizer。随后用 3B 参数指令微调语言模型进行监督微调，直接从用户上下文生成 SID。并系统消融 SID 构建、用户历史组成与长度、用户画像特征等设计。

Result: 结果表明跨平台 SID 可迁移到新的推荐表面；消融实验揭示了对实际部署最重要的设计选择，并为在真实社交平台上部署 GR 提供实践指导。

Conclusion: 跨平台语义 ID 与更广语料迁移能让生成式推荐在新稀疏场景（如 Forum）落地，并为工业界社交平台部署 GR 提供可操作经验。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as an alternative to embedding-based retrieval, building on the success of generative models in language and vision. We are exploring GR on Facebook Forum, a standalone application for medium-to-heavy users of Facebook Groups. Because Forum is a new surface, its own interaction data are too sparse to train a GR model from scratch. We address this with transfer along two axes: we train on a broader corpus of Facebook Groups engagements rather than Forum sessions alone, and we reuse hierarchical, prefix-based semantic IDs (SIDs) learned from cross-platform Facebook Feed data instead of fitting a Forum-specific tokenizer. A 3B-parameter instruction-tuned language model is then supervised-fine-tuned to generate SIDs directly from user context. We systematically ablate the design choices that matter most in practice, including SID construction, the composition and length of user history, and the inclusion of user-profile features. Our results show that cross-platform SIDs transfer to a new recommendation surface, and offer practical guidance for teams deploying GR on real-world social platforms.

</details>


### [452] [PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38807)
*Guanqun Yang,Yingming Zhou,Jiangrui Zheng,Shudong Hao,Xueqing Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PatchHolmes 是一个两阶段补丁检索系统：第一阶段混合检索，第二阶段用 listwise 智能体选取最佳提交，在 GitHubAD 上大幅超过 Favia 和 IRCoT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流漏洞库中 60%-63% 的 CVE 缺少补丁链接，补丁检索是漏洞管理的基础，但现有逐点打分方法效果有限。

Method: 两阶段：Phase 1 混合检索器；Phase 2 智能体一次性读取 top-100 候选列表，用四种带预算的工具选择性阅读 3-10 个提交，最终提交一个最佳候选。

Result: GitHubAD 上比 Favia 高 25.34% Recall@1、比 IRCoT 高 31.40%；仅一次智能体对话（Favia 需十次）。相同候选集下，智能体比取检索器 top-1 提升 27.32%。迁移到 PatchFinder_top10 将 Recall@1 从 24.28% 提升至 39.86%。

Conclusion: 增益来自 listwise 智能体循环而非 LLM 骨干（Qwen 家族内换模型变化<1%，gpt-oss 仍远超无智能体基线）；系统基于冻结开源模型和本地 Git 仓库运行，无需微调或外部搜索 API。

Abstract: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.

</details>


### [453] [SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38822)
*Guanqun Yang,Wenlong Zhang,Tian Shi,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SkillSeek用标准IR方法（BGE双编码器+小型交叉编码器，经MCP暴露）做agent技能两阶段检索，在SkillsBench上以近乎零额外成本达到LLM检索循环的同等效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源agent技能聚合已超23万，选择成为瓶颈。现有文献将选择外包给agent自身，用LLM中介的检索循环重写查询、精炼候选，但每个任务都消耗LLM token，成本高昂。

Method: SkillSeek，开源的two-stage技能检索器，遵循标准IR配方：BGE-base双编码器作第一阶段召回，小型交叉编码器精排，通过MCP暴露。在89任务SkillsBench基准上进行4×11的池、骨干、方法网格实验。

Result: 与Liu等的LLM检索循环达到观测持平：bm25在四个设置中的三个pass率不低于其精炼循环，小型交叉编码器补齐第四个设置差距。第一阶段的召回上限解释了该模式，每次试验总开销从51.30美元降至27.54美元（与无技能基线相差不到0.5美元）。

Conclusion: 在测试的SkillsBench任务和OpenHands框架下，标准IR配方是agent技能检索的强力默认方案；LLM中介方法适合确定性方法失效的场景。

Abstract: Anthropic's Agent Skills package reusable procedural know-how for an LLM agent into SKILL.md directories, and open-source aggregations have grown past 230,000 skills, making selection rather than authoring the bottleneck. The standing answer in the literature outsources selection to the agent itself: an LLM-mediated retrieval loop that rewrites queries and refines candidates inside the agent's decision loop, paying LLM tokens on every task. We present SkillSeek, an open-source two-stage skill retriever built from the standard IR recipe (a BGE-base bi-encoder feeding a small cross-encoder, exposed over MCP). Across a $4 \times 11$ grid of pool, backbone, and method on the 89-task SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSeek reaches observed parity with the LLM-mediated loop of Liu et al. at essentially no extra cost: plain bm25 alone records a pass rate at or above their refined loop on three of four settings, and a small cross-encoder covers the remaining difference on the fourth. A first-stage recall ceiling explains the pattern, and total per-trial spend drops from USD 51.30 to USD 27.54 (within fifty cents of the no-skill baseline). Under the SkillsBench tasks and OpenHands harness we tested, this positions the standard IR recipe as a strong default for agent-skill retrieval, with LLM-mediated alternatives a natural fit for cases where deterministic methods fall short.

</details>


### [454] [Text-Video Retrieval via Multi-Dimensional Saliency Assessment and Granularity-Aware Query Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38949)
*Shuquan Wei,Xi Chen,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Jia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出MMTI，联合缓解视觉冗余并实现多粒度文本-视频交互，在四个基准上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本-视频检索方法仅用单一方面标准评估视觉重要性，忽略视频的多维时空特性；同时将文本编码为单一全局嵌入，压缩了时序事件和空间实体，加剧跨模态错位。

Method: MMTI包含两个核心模块：1) 关键特征选择(KFS)，通过联合评估多维显著性与可学习重要性分数，自适应识别并聚合信息量大的帧和patch，压缩密集视觉特征；2) 多粒度文本-视频交互模块(TVIM)，用动态门控机制将文本查询分解为句子、帧、patch查询(SFP)，实现多粒度对齐。

Result: 在四个标准基准上大量实验表明，方法优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过联合缓解视觉冗余与多粒度文本-视频交互，MMTI实现了准确的多粒度语义对齐，验证了多维度建模与细粒度对齐的有效性。

Abstract: Text-video retrieval, which aims to bridge visual and textual modalities by learning a joint embedding space, has become a crucial task in multimodal intelligence. Despite extensive efforts to mitigate visual redundancy, previous methods typically rely on a single-aspect criterion to assess visual importance, overlooking the multifaceted spatiotemporal nature of video. In addition, encoding text into a single global embedding to align with videos compresses temporal events and spatial entities into a unified representation space, further aggravating cross-modal misalignment. To address these issues, we propose MMTI, a method that jointly mitigates visual redundancy and enables multi-grained text-video interaction to achieve accurate multi-grained semantic alignment. Specifically, a key feature selection (KFS) mechanism adaptively identifies and aggregates informative frames and patches by jointly evaluating multi-dimensional saliency and learnable importance scores, effectively compacting dense visual features and mitigating visual redundancy. Furthermore, our proposed multi-grained text-video interaction module (TVIM) employs a dynamic gating mechanism to decompose the text query into sentence, frame, and patch queries (SFP), enabling multi-grained text-video alignment. Complementary alignment at different granularities is thereby achieved. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [455] [When LLM-Inferred User Context Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38999)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在生产流媒体平台上，比较聚合嵌入与LLM生成的自然语言用户画像：LLM画像仅对约五分之一的探索型用户有效，而聚合画像对约五分之四的习惯型用户更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统中的上下文信息正从静态预定义变量转向从行为推断的隐表示；LLM可将非结构化交互历史渲染为自然语言摘要，形成主题化用户上下文。但目前这类生成式画像相对聚合嵌入的优势主要只在领域层面被刻画，适用条件尚不清晰。

Method: 在真实生产流媒体平台上，针对全目录排序评估语义用户画像策略。实验覆盖2×2设计：表示类型（聚合嵌入 vs. LLM生成）与上下文范围（整体历史 vs. 注意力融合的短期+长期上下文）。

Result: 两种表示的优劣取决于用户消费模式。习惯型消费（约占人口五分之四）下聚合画像持续更强；探索型用户（后续交互与历史语义偏离）下LLM画像更强。LLM画像存在流行度吸引效应：略微提升列表内多样性，但显著降低目录覆盖率和新颖度。

Conclusion: 上下文感知系统应根据推断出的消费模式选择画像策略，而非对所有用户统一使用一种表示。

Abstract: Contextual information in recommender systems is shifting from static, predefined variables toward latent representations inferred from behavior. Large language models support this shift by rendering an unstructured interaction history as a natural-language summary, which yields a thematic user context that can be encoded and used in place of an aggregate profile. The conditions under which such generated profiles outperform aggregate embeddings have received limited characterization mainly at the domain level. We evaluate semantic user-profiling strategies on a production streaming platform, ranking against the full catalog. The evaluation covers a 2*2 design space crossing representation type (aggregate or LLM-generated) with contextual scope (holistic history or attention-fused short-term and long-term contexts). The relative ordering of the two representation types is conditional on the user's consumption regime. Aggregate profiles are consistently stronger under habitual consumption, which characterizes approximately four-fifths of the population, while LLM-generated profiles are stronger for exploratory users whose subsequent interactions diverge semantically from their history. We also observe a popularity-attractor effect in LLM-generated profiles, which modestly raises within-list diversity while substantially lowering catalog coverage and reducing novelty. These results indicate that a context-aware system can select a profiling strategy from the inferred consumption regime rather than applying one representation to all users.

</details>


### [456] [RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39007)
*Junyeong Song,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RouteRec 用会话行为线索作为 MoE 路由依据，实现宏观/中观/微观三层专家分配，在六个数据集上取得最佳平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列推荐模型对所有会话用同一套参数化模块处理，忽略会话间的行为差异；MoE 虽支持条件计算，但缺乏明确的路由依据。

Method: 从会话历史中提取四类行为证据（交互节奏、物品组偏好、重复与延续、热门倾向），并将其用于宏观、中观、微观三个层级的专家路由：先由线索分数选择专家组，再由当前主干状态在组内细化专家选择。

Result: 在六个公开数据集的 18 个数据集-指标组合中，RouteRec 12 次排名第一、3 次第二，平均排名 1.61，优于次优基线的 4.11；分析表明行为线索带来超出单纯增加容量的收益，且路由模式与观察到的行为一致。

Conclusion: 观测到的会话行为可作为有效的 MoE 路由标准，提升序列推荐性能并产生行为一致的路由模式。

Abstract: Sessionized interaction histories contain behavioral patterns that can improve sequential recommendation. However, existing models process all sessions through the same parameterized blocks, regardless of their behavioral differences. Mixture of Experts (MoE) enables conditional computation, but it leaves open what should guide expert allocation. We propose RouteRec, a sequential recommender that uses observed session behavior as the routing criterion. RouteRec summarizes four types of behavioral evidence from sessionized histories: interaction tempo, item-group focus, repetition and carryover, and popularity tendency. It uses these cues to route computation at macro, mid, and micro scopes. Cue-derived scores first select expert groups; within each selected group, the current backbone state then refines expert selection. Across six public datasets and 18 dataset-metric combinations, RouteRec ranks first in 12 and second in three, yielding the best overall average rank of 1.61 compared with 4.11 for the next-best baseline. Additional analyses suggest that the behavioral cues guide expert allocation beyond added capacity and produce routing patterns aligned with observed behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/jy1559/RouteRec

</details>


### [457] [Routing Between Generative and Collaborative User Profiles: A Serving-Time Gate for Controllable Novelty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39043)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究在推荐系统中选择性调用LLM生成用户画像，通过服务时路由门控为用户分配协同模型或LLM画像模型，在NDCG损失预算5%下提升Novelty@10达6.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的语义用户画像虽能增强推荐，但生成成本高，且并非所有用户都适合统一使用。作者希望探究能否在生产推荐流程中有选择性地调用LLM画像。

Method: 使用真实流媒体数据集（电影、电视剧、体育），训练服务时路由门控，仅基于服务时特征将用户分配给协同序列推荐模型或LLM画像驱动的推荐模型；门控学习识别哪些用户可提升Novelty@10同时保持排序相关性，并通过路由阈值调节新颖性-相关性权衡。

Result: 在整体NDCG损失预算5%时，学到的门控将Novelty@10提升6.5%，同时路由12.5%用户，优于简单启发式和随机路由策略；非生成语义画像的结果表明收益来自选择性路由而非仅LLM生成。

Conclusion: LLM生成用户画像可作为协同推荐的互补可控组件，选择性路由是关键；该方案在有限相关性代价下实现新颖性提升。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable rich semantic user profiles for recommendation, but such profiles are more expensive to generate and are not necessarily desirable to deploy uniformly. We study whether LLM-generated profiles can instead be invoked selectively within a production recommendation pipeline. Using a real-world streaming dataset covering movies, TV shows, and sports content, we train a serving-time routing gate that assigns each user to either a collaborative sequential recommendation model or a recommendation model driven by an LLM-generated profile. The gate uses only serving-time features and learns to identify users for whom profile-based routing can increase Novelty@10 while preserving ranking relevance. A routing threshold controls how aggressively users are sent to the generative model, exposing a tunable novelty--relevance trade-off. At an overall NDCG-loss budget of 5\%, the learned gate increases Novelty@10 by 6.5\% while routing 12.5\% of users, outperforming simple heuristic and random routing policies at comparable relevance cost. These results show that LLM-generated user profiles can serve as a controllable complement to collaborative recommendation, while results with non-generative semantic profiles indicate that the benefit stems from selective routing rather than LLM generation alone.

</details>


### [458] [Learning Multiresolution Relevance for Hierarchical Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39312)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RARS将文档级相关性在多分辨率SID层级上展开为一致的细化级条件分布，用共享query表示做前缀条件监督，训练后丢弃predictor，推理仍为标准自回归检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一query的相关文档常共享粗粒度前缀、在细粒度分支上分歧，且分支模式随query变化；标准full-SID监督把这些路径当作独立目标，未显式建模相关性在逐级细化中的分配。

Method: 将多分辨率相关性形式化为由单一文档级相关性度量在SID层级上诱导的一致条件分布；RARS在prefix上聚合文档相关性，训练prefix-conditioned predictor在兄弟分支间分配相关性质量。所有带相关性的子节点参与局部竞争，每个局部损失按到达其父节点的相关性质量加权，从而监督共享query编码器同时学习粗结构与细化分支分配；predictor训练后丢弃，保持标准自回归检索。

Result: 在三个多语言ESCI locale上，自回归解码下相较匹配的full-SID训练取得一致提升；在统一检索规则下优于grouped soft-target、decoder soft-target与sampled-tree监督；增益在不同标识符结构和相关性定义下依然保持。

Conclusion: 显式建模SID层级上的多分辨率相关性分配可为生成式检索提供更有效的监督信号，且不改变推理流程，具有跨语言与跨标识符结构的稳健性。

Abstract: Generative retrieval with semantic identifiers (SIDs) makes successive decisions over a document hierarchy. Relevant documents for the same query may share coarse prefixes and diverge at finer depths, with branching patterns varying across queries. These paths reveal how relevance is distributed across successive refinements, yet standard full-SID supervision treats them as separate training targets. To make this allocation explicit, we formulate multiresolution relevance as consistent conditional distributions induced by a single document-level relevance measure across the SID hierarchy. We introduce \textbf{RARS}, \textbf{R}esolution-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{R}elevance \textbf{S}upervision, which uses the resulting refinement-level distributions to supervise a shared query representation. RARS aggregates document relevance over prefixes and trains a prefix-conditioned predictor to allocate relevance among sibling branches. All relevance-bearing children participate in local competition, and each local loss is weighted by the relevance mass reaching its parent. This objective trains the query encoder to capture both the coarse structure shared by relevant documents and their finer branch allocations. The predictor is discarded after training, preserving standard autoregressive retrieval at inference. Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/RARS

</details>


### [459] [Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39319)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ResTD将RQ索引中丢弃的残差轨迹信息通过蒸馏引入检索训练，提升多语言电商检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索用离散SID表示物品，RQ构建SID时仅监督被选码，丢弃了产生该码的残差轨迹与码字偏好信息，导致不同量化行为被坍缩为相同目标，且索引阶段信息未被检索训练利用。

Method: ResTD把冻结的RQ索引器当作过程教师，将残差诱导的码字偏好蒸馏到SID解码状态中，使早期解码状态在生成后续SID后缀前捕获后续量化决策信息；保持原检索索引与推理流程不变，并可扩展至生成式推荐。

Result: 多语言电商检索实验相对强基线及匹配训练对照有一致提升；残差目标优于仅基于码本的软目标；表征探针显示未来码本偏好可从早期解码状态更易恢复。

Conclusion: 利用SID构建中被丢弃的残差信息可增强检索学习，ResTD有效且可推广到生成式推荐。

Abstract: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/iclr2027_ResTD.git.

</details>


### [460] [Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39327)
*Shaowen Zeng,Yanhua Huang,Jiacheng Sun,Jiarui Liu,Qian Dai,Zhikai Yang,Hancheng Li,Boya Wu,Tuoyu Zhang,Yekui Chen,Xiang Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GEAR是一个端到端生成式检索推荐框架，通过BasisVQ/BasisRQ解决表征坍缩、通过上下文感知重排序解决物品冲突，已部署于抖音广告服务数亿日活用户。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索将推荐建模为离散物品token生成，但扩展到真实系统面临两大瓶颈：表征坍缩（tokenizer在分布漂移下退化）与物品冲突（海量候选中不同物品共享相同token序列）。且二者本质上耦合——扩大码本容量缓解冲突会加剧坍缩。

Method: 提出GEAR，联合优化tokenizer、生成器和重排序器。用BasisVQ通过正交基重参数化码本，实现全局梯度共享与潜在空间刚性旋转以稳定梯度；扩展为prefix-aware BasisRQ，在同等渐进时间复杂度下增强码本表达力；并集成上下文条件重排序头到生成过程，以低开销消解冲突物品。

Result: 在抖音广告服务数亿日活用户，大量在线A/B测试中取得显著经验提升。

Conclusion: 通过统一稳定tokenization与联合重排序，GEAR建立了完全可微、可扩展的生成式推荐范式，同时缓解坍缩与冲突两大耦合瓶颈。

Abstract: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

</details>


### [461] [When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39696)
*Sanjeev Suresh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文审计了LLM生成的对话推荐基准中"官方标签"与用户明确点歌请求不一致的问题：在TalkPlay基准中约半数可审计轮次标签与请求矛盾，作者提出训练时补充"满足请求的目标"可大幅提升冲突轮次表现且不损害官方指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM流水线生成的合成对话被当作完整基准，其标签由LLM推荐器所选轨迹决定，只是模拟用户真实请求的代理。而按名点播是真实音乐搜索的主导意图，部署系统通常不会用替代品顶替明确点名的歌曲，因此这些标签可能错误、误导评测与训练。

Method: 在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准中，仅利用可见对话与目录元数据，找出用户明确点名某首歌的轮次，直接比较官方标签与该请求是否一致（无需真值用户）。并设计小规模训练时补充：对一小部分训练轮次加入经目录解析、满足请求的目标；同时设置匹配对照组，检测同样请求但只用官方标签训练，以隔离效应。

Result: 在审计的开发集轮次中，官方标签有一半与用户点名请求矛盾。补充训练目标后，43个冲突轮次上nDCG@20获得53.3%的相对提升，且官方指标保持不变，对照实验证实增益来自请求满足目标而非请求检测本身。

Conclusion: 策略选定的合成标签可复现、可规模化，但当作真值会系统性偏离用户实际请求；在点名场景中这一偏差尤其严重。低成本训练时补充即可显著缓解，提示基准构建需区分"用户请求"与"策略选择"。

Abstract: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

</details>


### [462] [KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39828)
*Jiangxia Cao,Hao Peng,Wenlong Xu,Jiaxin Deng,Zhixin Ling,Xingmei Wang,Kun Shang,Can Tang,Zhihuai Cai,Jun Du,Fang Su,Xiaojuan Liu,Yiling Li,Chenglong Yu,Chongling Rao,Haixuan Gao,Haitao Xu,Jian Liang,Ruiming Tang,Chenglong Chu,Guohong Mu,Honghui Bao,Hui Wang,Jialong Chen,Jiao Ou,Muhao Wei,Peng Zhang,Renpu Liu,Ruochen Yang,Shugui Liu,Xinqi Jin,Yan Sun,Yifan Wang,Yingzhi He,Yufei Ye,Yusen Huo,Tingkuo Wang,Jihong Zhang,Lanxi Zhu,Pengyuan Liu,Zhipeng Yi,Luankang Zhang,Hang Lv,Xuyang Zhi,Tianyu Li,Bintao Wu,Chuang Ou,Siyue Su,Ziyuan Wang,Yuliang Sun,Baiyan Che,Feiyang Xu,Shiwen Zhang,Shiteng Cao,Chongcong Jiang,Yuan Fang,Xiangwu Yang,Hao Deng,Zijian Du,Pengxun Wang,Xiaoming Wang,Shun Qin,Yingqi Song,Tianyi Li,Naixiao Peng,Chenyu Zhou,Qiliang Jiang,Quan Zheng,Cheng Jin,Siying Zeng,Hongjia Xu,Junwu Hu,Teng Fu,Zhengkang Mei,Haijun Yu,Kai Li,Shengyang Zhou,Zhijia Wei,Siyi Xiong,Bo Liu,Zichun Guo,Zhubin Han,Jinpeng Fu,Bingqian Liu,Yuyi Wang,Yu Liu,Qinghai Tan,Ruijie Zhou,Zhuohang Li,Zhijia Zhong,Xiangnan He,Jirong Wen,Min Zhang,Wenwu Ou,Peng Jiang,Han Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Yanan Niu,Lantao Hu,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍Kuaishou联合SIGIR 2026举办的LLM-Rec挑战赛，主题为"推理式生成推荐"，并综述OneRec系列模型及其推理能力探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐与LLM浪潮下，团队开发了基于Semantic ID的OneRec/OneRec-V2并成功落地，但发现引入推理CoT并不总能提升推荐效果，需解决该问题并推动社区研究。

Method: 在OneRec基础上探索OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason等模型，将物品Semantic ID与自然语言统一到同一表示空间；OneReason通过强化物品-语言语义对齐、引入结构化模板监督兴趣推理，并应用先进强化学习技术。

Result: OneRec/OneRec-V2已在生产环境大规模部署，验证了自回归下一物品预测范式的规模化潜力；OneReason使推理更有利于推荐效果。

Conclusion: 推理式生成推荐是构建推荐基础模型的前沿方向，具有重要研究价值；团队联合SIGIR 2026举办KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026，鼓励更多研究者参与探索。

Abstract: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

</details>


### [463] [Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40241)
*Hanjia Lyu,Yinglong Xia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对决策导向模型Jev在个性化推荐重排任务上进行受控实证研究，比较其与推荐专用模型及Qwen重排器的效果与延迟，发现Jev在质量-延迟上处于独特权衡区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM用于推荐重排时面临推荐质量与服务效率的权衡。作者探究：当重排本质是对预定义候选项的结构化选择时，决策导向模型是否能提供有用替代方案。

Method: 在多个Amazon Reviews领域与不同候选集大小下，对TypeSafe AI的"System One Model" Jev进行受控实证研究，并与推荐专用模型、pointwise和listwise Qwen重排器对比，评估推荐效果与实际服务延迟。

Result: Jev相对所评估基线保持较强的推荐效果，其延迟增长比pointwise Qwen重排器更平缓，但实际服务延迟仍显著高于推荐专用模型。在不同候选规模与领域下，Jev处于独特的质量-延迟运行区间。

Conclusion: 这些发现支持进一步研究决策导向模型在推荐及其他具有结构化输出空间的排序任务中的应用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

</details>


### [464] [LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03756)
*Theresia Veronika Rampisela,Henrik Palmer Olsen,Giovanni Colavizza*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个来自CJEU判决的大规模法律IR数据集LegalPincite，解决现有数据集引用标注缺失与数据泄漏问题，支持多粒度检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律实践中常需段落级精确引用，但现有公开法律IR数据集多缺段落级标注；有的虽有却存在查询文本数据泄漏、排除非引用段落等问题，导致检索设定不真实、性能虚高。

Method: 从欧盟法院（CJEU）判决构建大规模法律IR数据集，包含：(i) 移除引用信息后的掩码案件/段落查询；(ii) 包含所有段落的语料库；(iii) 案件级与段落级真实引用标注，并部分经人类专家验证。

Result: 数据集支持案件到案件、段落到案件、段落到段落三种查询-文档粒度的检索，兼顾方法开发与严格评估。数据集与代码已开源（HuggingFace链接）。

Conclusion: 该数据集弥补了法律IR中段落级引用标注缺失和数据泄漏的不足，为多粒度法律检索提供更真实、严谨的评测基准。

Abstract: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

</details>
